title: The O-Ring Store: AS568-138 S70 FDA Silicone (VMQ) 70 Duro O-Ring, model S70138
supports: identity: AS568-138, S70 FDA silicone (VMQ) 70 Duro, model (SKU) S70138
dimensions: 2-1/8" ID x 2-5/16" OD x 3/32" CS nominal; actual 2.112" ID x 0.103" CS; metric 53.64 mm ID x 2.62 mm CS
colour: brick red; FDA
operating temperature: up to approximately 400 °F (204 °C), cold flexibility down to approximately -75 °F (-59 °C)
media: moderate water resistance; not compatible with silicone grease and oils, super-heated steam over 250 °F
price breaks and minimum quantity 10 (snapshot)

title: The O-Ring Store product data sheet: FDA Silicone 70 Durometer O-Ring, compound TORS VMQ-70 (legacy S70), Revision A
supports: material: silicone rubber, methyl vinyl siloxane, ISO 1629 VMQ; compression or transfer moulded
hardness 70 ± 5 Shore A (ASTM D2240 test value 70)
regulatory: FDA compliant to 21 CFR 177.2600 (formulation and test based claim, ASTM D2000 Z callout); not NSF/ANSI 51, NSF/ANSI/CAN 61, USP Class VI or 3-A certified; RoHS not on file
ASTM D2000 line callout MBGE606 A19 B37 EA14 EO36 F19 Z
specific gravity 1.38 (ASTM D297)
elongation 269 %; compression set 15 % (22 h at 175 °C, ASTM D395 B)
water: -2 Shore A / +3 % volume after 70 h at 100 °C
service temperature: -80 °F to +400 °F (-62 °C to +204 °C) continuous dry air; hot water below +212 °F (+100 °C); brittleness pass at -55 °C
static seals only; static squeeze 15 to 30 %; installed stretch under 5 %; gland fill 65 to 85 % at temperature; static surface finish 16 to 32 µin Ra
never lubricate with silicone grease; use a compatible FDA-grade lubricant
shelf life effectively unlimited under SAE ARP5316 storage
note: Saved as .research/downloads/ors-vmq-s70-datasheet.pdf (3 pages). The data sheet flags its own tensile figure (6.9) as a probable hundreds-of-psi shorthand; tensile is not used in the part.
